title: Outlook: More visibility into usage for recoverable items storage
description: You'll be able to see how much storage your recoverable items are using in Outlook. This gives you a clearer picture of your storage usage before you reach a limit. You can use this information to make more informed decisions about managing your mailbox. #newoutlookforwindows
